title: Being a Good Digital Citizen
tagline: Rights, respect, and wellbeing in online spaces.
description: The internet is a community too. Learn your rights, how to treat others with respect, how to deal with bullying, and how to look after your wellbeing.
outcomes: Know your rights online in Zambia

lessons.title: Your rights online
lessons.body:
In Zambia, the Data Protection Act of 2021 protects your personal information. Companies must tell you why they collect your data and keep it safe.

## You can ask
You can ask a company what information they hold about you, and ask them to correct or delete it.
key_points: Your data is protected by law
You can ask what data is held about you
lessons.try_it: Think of one app you use. Do you know what data it collects?

lessons.title: Dealing with online bullying
lessons.body:
Bullying online can hurt as much as bullying in person.

## What to do
Do not reply to the bully. Take a screenshot as proof. Block and report the account. Talk to someone you trust, like a parent, teacher or facilitator.
lessons.try_it: Find the block button in WhatsApp for a contact, without pressing it.

lessons.title: Balancing screen time
lessons.body:
Phones are useful, but too much time on them can affect sleep and family time.

## Simple habits
Put the phone away during meals. Stop using it one hour before sleep. Turn off notifications from apps you do not need.
lessons.try_it: Turn off notifications for one app you do not need.

quiz.question: Which law protects personal data in Zambia?
quiz.explanation: The Data Protection Act No. 3 of 2021 protects your personal information.

quiz.question: Someone is bullying you online. What should you NOT do?
quiz.explanation: Replying can make it worse. Save proof, block, report and talk to someone.
